title: 12 Best Brunch Spots in Accra
description: Discover the 12 best brunch spots in Accra, Ghana, from trendy cafes to luxurious hotel buffets. Find your perfect weekend meal, whether you're on a budget or seeking a lavish experience.

places.name: Cafe Kwae
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Pancake Stack' with fresh berries and local honey, or the 'Kelewele & Egg' for a Ghanaian twist.

places.name: The Loft
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs' is always a winner, or try their unique 'Jollof Rice Arancini' for a fusion experience.

places.name: Capitol Cafe & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Capitol Benedict' is a must-try, or indulge in their 'Full English Breakfast' for a hearty start.

places.name: Kukun
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Acai Bowls' are fantastic, or try one of their customizable omelets with a side of freshly squeezed juice.

places.name: Bistro 22
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'French Toast' made with brioche is divine, or opt for the 'Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel' for a classic.

places.name: Urban Table
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Shakshuka' is a flavorful standout, or choose a 'Breakfast Burrito' for a hearty and portable option.

places.name: Zen Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the extensive Sunday brunch buffet – try a bit of everything from their sushi to their omelet station and grilled meats.

places.name: La Chaumiere
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Croque Madame' or 'Steak Frites' (smaller portion for brunch) offer a truly authentic French experience.

places.name: Bôndai Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Sushi Platters' are always a hit, or try the 'Tuna Tataki' for a fresh and flavorful start.

places.name: Tea Baa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair any of their exotic teas with a fresh 'Scone with Clotted Cream and Jam' or a 'Toasted Sandwich'.

places.name: Labadi Beach Hotel (Sunday Brunch)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in the full Sunday brunch buffet, focusing on the fresh seafood, carving stations, and decadent dessert spread.

places.name: Movenpick Ambassador Hotel (Sunday Brunch)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their diverse stations, from the cheese and charcuterie to the Asian corner, and don't miss the chocolate fountain for dessert.
